ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black pigmentation across the entire fluke area with sparse, irregular white focal spots and mottling concentrated primarily along the lower margins and trailing edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with varying pixel-amplitudes; includes both sharp peaks and rounded valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve originating from the distal tips and sweeping symmetrically toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular and semi-circular high-contrast white pixel clusters, consistent with barnacle attachment scars, distributed across the central and lower ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigment, notably visible in the central and right lobe regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of protuberant, high-contrast barnacle colonization at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, causing significant textural irregularity.
other_distinctive_markers: Ring-like scarring patterns on the right lobe and large white focal points near the lower leading edge.
